nodes.summary: The boundary of a normalized univalent image of the disc is within distance one of the origin. Let $D=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|<1\}$ be the unit disk and suppose $f:D\to\mathbb{C}$ is an injective holomorphic function with $f(0)=0$ and $f'(0)=1$. Let $\Omega=f(D)$ and let $\partial\Omega$ be its boundary. Then $\mathrm{dist}(0,\partial\Omega)=\inf\{|z|:z\in\partial\Omega\}\le 1$.
nodes.title: The boundary of a normalized univalent image of the disc is within distance one of the origin

nodes.summary: Let $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ be holomorphic and injective on the open unit disk $\mathbb{D} = \{z : |z| < 1\}$, with $f(0) = 0$ and $f'(0) = 1$. Then the image $f(\mathbb{D})$ contains the open disk $\{w : |w| < 1/4\}$.
